errors.evidence: The y-axis range is from 52% to 62%, not 52% to 60% as stated.
The label in the legend is “本文方法” (This paper's method), not “本技法”.

errors.text_span: 一个用条纹图案表示，标签为“本技法”，颜色为灰色；另一个用条纹图案表示，标签为“基线模型”，颜色为黑色
errors.evidence: The color descriptions are incorrect. The “本文方法” bar is white with black stripes, not grey. The “基线模型” bar is grey with black stripes, not black.
The description fails to mention the grouped structure of the bar chart, where each category on the x-axis has two bars for comparison.

errors.text_span: “近”模式的柱状图的长度约为 58%， “中”模式的柱状图的长度约为 57%， “远”模式的柱状图的长度约为 56%。
errors.evidence: This sentence improperly summarizes each category with a single value, completely ignoring that there are two distinct bars (for “本文方法” and “基线模型”) in each category. This misses the primary comparative point of the chart. The values provided are also inaccurate representations of the data for both bars in each category.
The x-axis label is “要素距离” (element distance), not “模式” (modes).
